# Meterless H-MEM — upstream attribution

This directory contains the H-MEM reference implementation from:

https://github.com/Meterless/Meterless

Upstream path: engines/hmem/reference

License: Apache License, Version 2.0.
See LICENSE in this directory.

The H-MEM reference implementation is vendored for integration
with WORKSHIFT AI. It uses deterministic mock embeddings and
should not be represented as a production semantic embedding engine.
